THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS an Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the Statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies thisorder exists between,
Mr. T. Nelson A. Fernando, No. 608/1, Galle Road, Panadura. of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05.of the other part,

Now therefore I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamuwa Development do byvirtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956Revised Edition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act,No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint,
Mr. Nandasena Bedigama, No. 16/6, Kovilwatta, Getamanna Road, Beliatta to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him forsettlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relationsand Sabaragamuwa Development.Colombo,10th April, 2018.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. T. Nelson A. Fernando, No. 608/1, Galle Road, Panadura. of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05.of the other part,
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether Mr. T. Nelson A. Fernando who had worked as a Grade V Officer (Court Officer) of the Kalutara Regional Office ofthe Sri Lanka Transport Board and worked in the same post on contract basis from 02/05/2011 to 28/10/2015 after retirement hadbeen caused injustice by the non-payment of salary relevant to the post, annual increments and increased allowances for theservices rendered during the period and if such injustice had been caused, to what reliefs he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.Dated at the office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo this 22nd day of March 2018.

Mr. Nandasena Badigama, No. 16/6, Kovilwatta, Gatamanna Road, Beliatta to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him forsettlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relationsand Sabaragamuwa Development.Colombo,10th April, 2018.

STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether the non-payment of the salary scale relevant to the grade to Mr. M. J. Chandrathilaka working as an AssistantManager (Engineering) of Grade V at the Gampaha Regional office of the Sri Lanka Transport Board is just and if not so, to whatreliefs he is entitled."
